issues.where: the storm, especially across the cottage, upper bowl and foreground pond
issues.what: Long, thin, nearly parallel tracks and broad translucent green sweeps read like a veil laid over the same clear scene. The target has a brighter, more three-dimensional churn: many more short hot streaks and tumbling orange fragments, with near flakes visibly interrupting the roof, lower trunk and water.
issues.fix: Break up the broad sweeps, use more short bright tracks at mixed depths and directions, and bring overlapping near-field streaks and blurred leaf fragments across the miniature and pond. Restore the luminous turquoise backscatter behind the cottage and along the lower shoulder.

issues.where: the liquid above and around the cottage and tree
issues.what: A dense canopy of similarly glowing gold dots, flat repeating orange leaves and hard round foreground disks gives the liquid a confetti-and-fairy-light look. The target has more dark breathing room and a stronger separation between tiny hot embers, individually lit leaves and a few soft out-of-focus shapes.
issues.fix: Reduce and de-cluster the amber dots, especially overhead. Vary leaf size, turn, focus and side-light by depth, replace the conspicuously perfect disks with subtler blurred shapes, and leave more dark gaps.

issues.where: the top and side shoulders of the glass
issues.what: The particularly wide cream highlight at the upper right and the smooth amber wrap at the upper left flatten the glass into a bright outline. The target has a cool double edge over the crown, finer surface texture, and curved, broken warm glints farther down the shoulder.
issues.fix: Narrow and break up the warm reflection, add a separately readable cool outer edge and inner refracted highlight, and recover the curved localized glints and subtle glass texture.

issues.where: the top and side shoulders of the shaken glass
issues.what: The cream band at the upper right and even yellow-green arc make the storm appear to run right to a thin shell. The target retains a distinct blue-cyan outer rim and a curved white inner reflection that separates the thick glass from the moving liquid.
issues.fix: Separate the glass and storm optically with a cool doubled contour, a tighter white inner reflection and localized warm shoulder glints rather than a broad cream band.

issues.where: the three carved faces set into the base
issues.what: The cutouts have a different, immediately apparent expression: sharp slanted eyes, a nearly absent face on the right, and a square-toothed central grin instead of rounder faces with separated triangular cuts and a broad ragged mouth. Their glow is flat and bright at the cut edges, and the shells read almost solid black rather than ribbed dark orange.
issues.fix: Keep the faces unobstructed, but restore the triangular eyes and noses, uneven broad grins, rounder ribbed shells and hotter interiors with reddish light grazing the carved edges.

issues.where: the three carved faces set into the base
issues.what: The slanted eyes and square-toothed central mouth still read as different carvings through the shake, and the right face loses a clearly separated eye-and-nose arrangement. The target shows rounder ribbed pumpkin shells and softer warm light around the jagged cuts.
issues.fix: Use the target's face shapes, shell ribbing and warm edge bounce without letting the stems cover them.

issues.where: the cottage roof, chimney, front wall, door and windows
issues.what: The bright rounded masonry, uniform brown door, short-looking chimney, and flat window colors make the house read like a different model. The target has finer, darker stonework, a substantial block chimney, more irregular slate and roof edges, a recessed dark plank door and more luminous green and magenta glazing.
issues.fix: Darken and refine the masonry and mortar, deepen the door recess, restore the target roof and chimney profiles and texture, and give the green and violet windows brighter local cores with restrained bloom.

issues.where: the cottage and lamp behind the moving liquid
issues.what: The pale rounded wall stones, even door, relatively neat roof and broad flat lamp head remain legible as different shapes through the storm. The target's finer dark masonry, recessed door and slim warm lantern produce a more localized pool of light.
issues.fix: Carry the target's darker stone and irregular roof structure through the storm, and use a narrower black lantern cage with a concentrated amber light and lower spill.

issues.where: the tree crown, trunk and bats
issues.what: The crown bunches into a more vertical angular tangle, with thicker crossing branches and gold lights throughout; the target has a legible branching silhouette with longer sideways sweeps and fine tapered tips. The bats are oversized and clustered and have diffuse edges instead of the target's few small, crisp silhouettes with depth between them.
issues.fix: Restore the taper and sideways reach of the branches, bring back warm side-lit bark detail and reduce apparent surface lights. Use fewer, smaller, sharper bats placed at different depths.

issues.where: the airspace above the cottage and at the right shoulder
issues.what: The small readable dark bat silhouettes that punctuate the target storm are lost; the orange and green motion has few comparable dark silhouettes to establish depth.
issues.fix: Keep a few small, distinct silhouettes in front of and behind the bright paths without sharpening the entire storm.

issues.where: the fence, front path, lantern and miniature pumpkins at the cottage and pond edge
issues.what: The fence posts are heavier and closer, the path is brighter and more block-like, the lantern glows as a broad soft yellow patch, and the miniature jack-o'-lantern glow loses the definition of its carved details. The ground is covered with flatter, more uniformly vivid orange leaf scatter.
issues.fix: Thin and angle the weathered rails, use irregular cooler stepping stones, tighten the lantern glow into a black-framed head with local spill, keep the small carvings crisp, and darken and vary the leaf litter.

issues.where: the pond, shoreline and green refraction just above the collar
issues.what: The pond has less of a rounded rock-edged basin and weaker distinct amber reflections. A uniformly thick band of mottled green at the glass foot covers the edge and reads like an opaque texture rather than luminous depth.
issues.fix: Restore the curved stone-and-grass bank, deep teal water and separate broken reflections, and turn the lower green strip into a smoother translucent refraction with dark pockets.

issues.where: the fence, stepping stones and pond at the foreground
issues.what: The oversized front rails and blocky path stay too clearly separated from the water. The pond shows a neat central glint and the same dark green mottled foot, whereas the target breaks up the foreground with a denser bright streak layer and broader warm water reflections.
issues.fix: Restore the low weathered fence and irregular path, use broken warm reflections, and layer the foreground storm into the lower glass instead of ending it above a fixed green band.

issues.where: the collar, base body, thorn winding and web
issues.what: The near-continuous pale collar and bright, skinny wax threads look much cleaner than the irregular amber wax seat. The prominent brown ridged stems and regularly layered loops flatten the base, where the target is darker and more asymmetric, with chunkier black thorns, broken iron relief and fine cool web strands.
issues.fix: Break and darken the collar into uneven pooled wax and drips. Retain the permitted separating rim, but darken the stems, vary their profiles and overlaps away from the faces, recover the irregular cast-iron relief and thin the web threads.

issues.where: the collar, base body, thorn winding and web
issues.what: The pale collar, thin light wax threads, exposed grey side panel and layered brown ridged thorn coils read as cleaner materials than the target's irregular wax seat and dark gnarled iron-and-thorn mass.
issues.fix: Use pooled amber wax, rougher dark iron facets, uneven thick black briars and fine cool web strands. Keep the permitted edge separation and the lit faces clear.

issues.where: the tabletop, mirror image and lights behind the globe
issues.what: The orange reflections are wider and more evenly smeared; the leaves read as larger crisp flat shapes rather than irregular, partly blurred debris mixed with wet specks. The upper-left background light has cooled nearly to blue-grey instead of a warm amber, and the low background pinlights have been muted.
issues.fix: Break the warm mirror glows into narrower uneven reflections, use curled and variably focused leaves with a few wet specular flecks, and bring back the warm upper-left and dim low background lights.

issues.where: the tabletop and lights behind the globe
issues.what: Cleaner orange streaks and sharply defined leaf cutouts lose the target's uneven, glossy reflected pools and moist surface detail. The muted cool upper-left light and missing low warm glints also change the surrounding light.
issues.fix: Introduce broken orange reflections and localized fine wet highlights, soften foreground and far leaves by depth, and restore the warm defocused lights to the left and near the tabletop horizon.
